featured_reviews.name: Mack D'Souza
featured_reviews.review_text:
Absolutely dreadful experience. My order for an alpha bed and mattress, placed on August 4th, 2023, turned into an ongoing nightmare. To start, they botched the delivery on August 5th, providing the wrong bed, and to make matters worse, the delivered bed was broken as the accompanying pictures attest.

As if the wrong and broken bed weren't enough, the mattress they provided proved to be incredibly uncomfortable. Without delay, I sought to cancel the mattress order. From that point forward, my days have been filled with ceaseless calls to their customer service, spanning well over five days.

After much anticipation, they finally took action on the 10th of August, only to replace the erroneous bed with yet another damaged and incorrect model. Throughout this entire ordeal, the uncomfortable mattress lingers in my possession, and their indifference toward facilitating a return is staggering.

Adding insult to injury, I find an email in my inbox on August 11th, 2023, declaring my issue resolved. Each time I've mustered the patience to contact their customer service, the response has been depressingly uniform: "We are escalating your issue." Regrettably, the direction or purpose of this supposed escalation remains an enigma to me.

I must emphasize that my prior experience with Rentmojo had been devoid of any issues, making the stark contrast with this current company all the more disappointing. It is my candid opinion that this company's performance falls far below par.

UPDATE on 16th August 2023 - Still stuck with the mattress and the wrong bed. Absolutely no communication from their team.
